verdict: Yes. Blue Tea pitched ayurvedic herbal teas on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal, with one of the higher revenue figures among beverage pitches. Herbal teas are light, keep for months and sell well online and in gifting.
angle: Butterfly pea, hibiscus, tulsi and chamomile teas sell to buyers looking for caffeine-free, healthy drinks. The product is dry and light, so shipping is cheap and shelf life is long. Keep health claims within FSSAI and AYUSH rules.
